newsitem.title: UK: Ulster Unionists to form alliance with Goldsmith.
newsitem.headline: Ulster Unionists to form alliance with Goldsmith.

text.p: The Ulster Unionist Party was expected on Monday to announce a political alliance with Sir James Goldsmith's Referendum Party in the European Parliament.

James Nicholson, the only Ulster Unionist Euro-MP, is to join Goldsmith's Europe of Nations political grouping in the European Parliament. Until now Nicholson has sat with the pro-European People's Party, which includes the British Conservative Euro-MPs.
The linkup is expected to be announced by Ulster Unionist leader David Trimble at a Belfast news conference.

Multi-millionaire Goldsmith, already a member of the European Parliament, will fight the next British general election on a platform calling for a referendum on closer integration with the European Union.

Goldsmith's party currently has no seats in the British parliament and it was not immediately clear what effect the alliance with the fiercely pro-British Ulster Unionists in the European parliament would have on domestic politics.
